# HexPiece 3.2.1

The fruit energy bar is now one universal bar: the same violet for every fruit (your call: "make them one color and call it a day"),
so new fruits never need a bar of their own. Nothing else changed. Not tested in game yet: the build and tests pass, and the bar was
rendered and checked full, after a move, low and refused.

**Fruit energy bar**
- One colour for every fruit: violet (none of the game's own bars is violet, so it never gets mixed up with health, hunger, XP or air).
- Everything else stays as in 3.2.0: right over the food bar, the little swirled fruit emblem on its right end, what a move just cost
  shown in white for a moment, blinking when low, a red flash and shake when a move is refused.
